turns.text: Could you check how booking the studio space works at Foothill Art Studio and what an hour costs me? There should be a booking sheet in the studio folder and an email from them about it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
Here's what I found.

**Cost:** $14.00/hour — part hours charged as full hours.

**How booking works:**
- Bookings taken **only at the studio desk** (not by phone or email). The desk can book up to two weeks ahead.
- Payment is required **at the time of booking** — an enquiry doesn't hold the room.
- Cancellation: charged in full if less than 24 hours' notice; otherwise refunded or moved.

**When the room is available:**
- Studio open Mon–Sat, 09:00–22:00, closed Sunday.
- The space **cannot** be booked while evening sections run in it: Tuesdays & Thursdays, 18:30–21:00. Those hours aren't offered at the desk.

**In the room:** Tables, easels, a sink. You bring your own materials. Work must be cleared after each booking — no storage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it, fourteen an hour at the desk. That covers what I needed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted — $14/hr at the desk, in person, up to two weeks ahead. Happy to book a slot whenever you're ready.
